name: Wellness Retreats in India
headline: Rejuvenate Your Body, Mind & Spirit with Ayurveda
intro: India is globally known for its authentic Ayurveda wellness retreats, where patients and travelers experience a complete reset of body and mind. These retreats combine detox therapies, yoga, meditation, herbal healing, and personalized diets in serene natural locations. Whether you seek recovery after medical treatment, stress relief, or a preventive health boost — Ayurveda retreats in India provide holistic healing at an affordable cost.
destinations: Kerala Backwaters: Authentic Ayurveda with beachside retreats
Rishikesh & Himalayas: Spiritual healing with yoga & Ayurveda
Goa: Relaxation retreats combining Ayurveda & beach life
Delhi-NCR & Gurugram: Urban retreats with modern facilities
why_choose: Authentic Ayurveda practiced by certified doctors
Affordable packages compared to global wellness resorts
Serene natural locations – beaches, backwaters, mountains
Customized programs for medical recovery & wellness
